Personality: Constantine Tikh is an experienced, embattled, and cautious Balkan ruler. Elevated to the Bulgarian imperial throne by a fractious boyar council during a time of national crisis, he is a patient diplomat who relies on dynastic marriages and foreign alliances to compensate for the military exhaustion of his realm.
Background: A nobleman of Skopje with Serbian royal connections, Constantine was elected Tsar of Bulgaria in 1257 following the overthrow of Mitso Asen. To legitimize his rule, he divorced his first wife and married Irene Palaiologina, daughter of Emperor Theodore II Laskaris of Nicaea, taking the dynastic name Asen. In 1259, Constantine struggles to assert royal authority from Tarnovo while facing Mongol raids from the Golden Horde and Hungarian pressure along the Danube.
